name: import
description: The full import path driven by a transcript recorded from a live Greenbone appliance (gvmd 25.2.1, GMP 22.6) over the gvmd UNIX socket. Addresses, MACs and UUIDs are redacted and TLS certificate material is stripped, but the XML is otherwise byte-for-byte what gvmd emitted: element order, the mix of single- and double-quoted attributes, entity-escaped NVT names, empty elements, and the tail-text encodings the parser depends on. Two real pages are replayed -- the report's first page and its real tail page, which is short and therefore ends the walk. Between them they cover the outer/inner <report> nesting; results grouped by host across a page boundary; the <ports> summary, where the port string is the TAIL text after <host> rather than the element's own text; host <detail> blocks carrying best_os_txt, best_os_cpe, MAC, ports/tcp_ports CSV and a Services triple; CPE-named details whose value is the port location, plus App details naming application CPEs; a 'general/CPE-T' pseudo-port and an app CPE whose location is a bare '/'; and an <errors> section whose <error> children are shaped almost exactly like results and carry negative severities. Errors are kept in the fixture precisely so they cannot be mistaken for results: a negative severity reaching Vulnerability(severityScore=) is floored at 0.0 by the platform and fails the ENTIRE record, so the importer must read only results/result. Host 1 deliberately yields no software -- its only CPE detail is an OS CPE (cpe:/o:), which the importer does not treat as an application. The namespaced_ids invariant is skipped because the importer adopts gvmd's bare asset UUID as the runZero id; that is a real deviation from the repo convention and is reported separately, not something this fixture should silently bless.
